Settings

Derives through cfg_attr.

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Settings {
    /// Only with a feature.
    #[cfg(feature = "extra")]
    pub extra: u32,

    #[cfg(feature = "fast")]
    #[cfg(unix)]
    pub both: u8,
}

impl Settings {
    /// Also gated, with its own cfg.
    #[cfg(feature = "methods")]
    #[cfg(windows)]
    pub fn doubly(&self);

    /// Gated by the impl's cfg.
    #[cfg(feature = "methods")]
    pub fn gated(&self);
}
